dedupe_keys.name: nebula england and wales postcode building energy context

description: The Cambridge NEBULA team publishes postcode-indexed neighbourhood context for domestic energy modelling in England and Wales. The current repository version has filtered and unfiltered CSVs plus variable and supplementary files. Its own page describes 232 variables across building stock, typology, age, urban form, climate, regions and socio-demographics; the article abstract reports 609,964 neighbourhood samples. Version 2 states CC BY 4.0 and free public access, replacing a more restrictive licence on version 1. The tables can support building-energy and retrofit simulations with model-energyplus after mapping postcode aggregates to building archetypes. A caveat is that postcode statistics are not household-level meter readings, and some underlying inputs were accessible under academic licences. Filters and privacy aggregation affect which neighbourhoods appear. The current own page and manifest were read without downloading the gigabyte-scale CSVs or checking individual columns. The separate generation code has its own licence.
